name: agent-charter
description: Build from the spec. Check against the source. Plugins for directing AI agents: fresh-context review, decision councils, best-of-n solutions, risk evaluation and a reasoning specialist.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Fresh eyes on any work (code against its spec, plans, decisions, documents, filings), judged from the governing sources and first principles.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Deliberation tools, one per question: decision-council when a costly call is yours to make (independent specialists advise), best-of-n when you want a problem solved and built after comparing distinct approaches (drafted in parallel from different starting points when the problem is open-ended, and measured when checks can tell the finalists apart), risk-evaluation for what could go wrong with one plan, and ask-specialist for one bounded, hard question.

plugins.name: figma-workflow
plugins.description: Governance for Figma to frontend, on top of Figma's MCP server and Code Connect: plan a screen from its Figma frame (new or changed) with a mapping table and one approval, build it as a clickable no-backend prototype, keep it in sync as the design changes, and audit it independently. Stack adapters for server-rendered and component stacks.
